name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 6:1 contrast. This balances visibility for keyboard users with modern display clarity, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA while avoiding the harshness of a 7:1 ring at 3px. The trade-off is slightly less crisp focus for users with perfect vision, but it ensures readability for those with mild visual impairments and works better on mobile screens.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring at 6:1 still risks blending into busy backgrounds on mobile—use a 5px ring at 7:1 instead. That keeps the focus ring crisp for all users, including those with low vision, without sacrificing touch precision. Test it on a high-contrast mobile background to settle the argument.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 5px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. This keeps the ring crisp and unmissable on mobile and low-vision screens while still meeting WCAG 2.2 AA. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring on desktop, but that’s a minor visual cost compared to the clarity it guarantees for touch and screen-reader users.

name: Reader
text: The 5px ring at 7:1 risks crowding small touch targets on mobile—especially for users with motor impairments—where precision matters more than contrast. A better alternative is a 4px ring at 7:1, tested on both high-contrast and busy backgrounds to confirm it doesn’t blend. Settle it by measuring tap accuracy in a live prototype with 10+ users of varying dexterity.
